title: helianthus laciniatus subsp. crenatus
intro: Helianthus laciniatus subsp. crenatus, commonly known as the cutleaf sunflower, is a plant species in the sunflower family that is native to North America. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including fever, sore throat, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Helianthus laciniatus subsp. crenatus include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help in reducing swelling and fighting infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory activities.
